description: This file defines the 'Tableselect' class, a Drupal form element for rendering tables with selectable rows via checkboxes or radio buttons, including methods for rendering, processing, and handling values.

classes.name: Tableselect
classes.description: A Drupal form element class for rendering a table with selectable rows using checkboxes or radio buttons.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns default properties and configuration for the tableselect element.

methods.name: valueCallback
methods.description: Handles the default value processing for the tableselect element based on whether multiple selection is enabled.

methods.name: preRenderTableselect
methods.description: Prepares the tableselect element for rendering by generating table rows with checkboxes or radios, and adding a 'select all' checkbox if needed.

methods.name: processTableselect
methods.description: Creates checkbox or radio input elements for each table row, configuring their default states and attributes.
